INSERT INTO sync_state (page_id, last_edited, content_hash, title, slug, folder, summary, synced_at)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, '')::timestamptz, $3, $6, $4, $7, $8, now())
ON CONFLICT (page_id) DO UPDATE
SET last_edited = EXCLUDED.last_edited,
    content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
    folder = EXCLUDED.folder,
    summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
    synced_at = now()
WHERE sync_state.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content_hash
RETURNING page_id, $4::text AS slug, $5::text AS content
SELECT page_id, title, slug, folder, summary FROM sync_state ORDER BY folder NULLS FIRST, title
